about: The run is started with the typed request 'put the ferry lines in idea-tobias'. One piece under 2026-09-20, with no comment in it: the tagged swim line and the untagged summers line. u1 (trigger `tag`) moves the swim line to idea-tobias and is approved; the findings list the summers line as missed. The Edit guard gives [] and the run closes. Keep it until this migrates.' above 'The next migration run tries this again.' The comment and the missed line stay off the handled list.
